title: AReaL: A Large-Scale Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning System for Language Reasoning
authors_zh: Wei Fu、Jiaxuan Gao、Xujie Shen、Chen Zhu、Zhiyu Mei、Chuyi He、Shusheng Xu、Guo Wei、Jun Mei、Jiashu Wang、Tongkai Yang、Binhang Yuan、Yi Wu
paper_type_zh: 异步强化学习系统、程序化奖励契约与轨迹血缘披露审计
best_for_zh: 关注大规模异步 RL、策略陈旧性、跨版本 rollout、程序化验证器和系统可复现性的研究者与工程人员
one_line: AReaL releases Apache-2.0 infrastructure and a NeurIPS asynchronous PPO recipe for math/code RL, but no canonical reasoning corpus, paper-run rollout/reward ledger, immutable data split or final-checkpoint provenance package was verified.
AReaL 发布了用于数学/代码 RL 的 Apache-2.0 异步 PPO 基础设施和 NeurIPS 系统配方；未核验到规范推理语料、论文运行 rollout/奖励账本、不可变数据切分或最终检查点溯源包。
why: It makes asynchronous RL's operational feedback contract inspectable—especially stale and cross-version rollouts—while demonstrating that high-throughput code and reported hyperparameters do not by themselves disclose source rights, reward decisions, trajectory lineage or evaluator validity.
inclusion_reason: A NeurIPS 2025 systems contribution that makes the policy-version, staleness, reward-service and replay-buffer contracts of asynchronous RL explicit, while showing the large provenance and verification gap between runnable infrastructure and an auditable reasoning-data release.

title: Problem
问题
html: AReaL is curated for the Frontier Reports and Data Disclosure Ledger as an asynchronous RL systems disclosure, not a released reasoning dataset. Its NeurIPS experiments name DeepScaleR for math and DeepCoder for code, but do not publish prompt files, record identifiers, preprocessing, source versions or a source-mixture ledger. A rollout worker continuously generates a single-turn question-to-reasoning-response trajectory. A weight update can interrupt decoding, discard and recompute the old-weight KV cache, then continue an unfinished sequence, so a stored trajectory can contain segments produced by multiple policy versions. The reported record fields include prompt, generated token, reasoning response, final answer, extracted code, unit-test result, reward, behavior and proximal policy version, staleness and trajectory. No paper-run rollout, token-logprob, policy-span or reward-event export is verified.

AReaL 被纳入“前沿报告与数据披露账本”，因为它披露的是异步 RL 系统，而不是已发布的推理数据集。NeurIPS 实验将 DeepScaleR 命名为数学来源、DeepCoder 命名为代码来源，但没有发布提示文件、记录标识、预处理、来源版本或来源混合账本。rollout worker 持续生成从单轮问题到推理回答的轨迹。权重更新能够中断解码，丢弃并重算旧权重 KV cache，再继续未完成序列，因此保存的轨迹可以包含由多个策略版本产生的片段。报告的字段包括提示、生成 token、推理回答、最终答案、抽取代码、单元测试结果、奖励、行为/近端策略版本、陈旧度和轨迹。未核验到论文运行 rollout、token logprob、策略跨度或奖励事件导出。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The feedback contract is programmatic and outcome-only. The reward service gives plus five for a correct final answer and minus five otherwise; nonzero reward appears only at the final action. Math uses rule-based string matching. Coding extracts code and executes unit tests. Completion or configured generation limits stop a rollout, while interruption for a weight load is not a task-success predicate. This identifies feedback categories but not a unified verifier artifact: exact math parser and matching rules, code-extraction behavior, unit-test suite and sandbox versions, edge cases, raw decisions and per-record terminal reasons are not published as one audit ledger.

其反馈契约是程序化且仅关注结果。奖励服务对正确最终答案给正五分，对其他答案给负五分；非零奖励只出现在最终动作。数学使用基于规则的字符串匹配；代码任务抽取代码并执行单元测试。生成完成或达到配置限制会停止 rollout，而为加载权重而中断并不是任务成功谓词。这明确了反馈类别，但没有形成统一的验证器工件：精确数学解析器和匹配规则、代码抽取行为、单元测试套件和沙盒版本、边界情况、原始判定以及逐记录终止原因没有作为一个审计账本发布。

title: Method
方法
html: The system separates GPU rollout and trainer clusters, overlaps CPU reward service and TCP transfer with generation, and uses interruptible rollout workers, a controller and a single-use replay buffer. The controller rate-limits or rejects requests that exceed a maximum staleness, prioritizes older buffer entries and updates rollout weights after trainer updates. Staleness-aware decoupled PPO separates behavior and proximal policy; it uses no critic or reference model, GAE lambda and gamma of one, global-batch advantage normalization, four minibatches, Adam and distributed parameter storage. Reported settings are 512 prompts per batch, 16 answers per prompt, temperature/top-p 1.0, fixed seed 1, eta 8 for math and eta 4 for code unless noted. The configuration table states 27,648 maximum generated tokens, while Table 1 says 32K; no immutable run configuration resolves that difference.

该系统分离 GPU rollout 与 trainer 集群，并将 CPU 奖励服务和 TCP 传输与生成重叠；它使用可中断 rollout worker、控制器和单次使用的 replay buffer。控制器对超出最大陈旧度的请求限速或拒绝，优先旧缓冲条目，并在 trainer 更新后更新 rollout 权重。陈旧度感知的解耦 PPO 分离行为策略与近端策略；它不使用 critic 或 reference model，GAE lambda 和 gamma 均为一，采用全局 batch 优势归一化、四个 minibatch、Adam 和分布式参数存储。报告设置为每 batch 512 个提示、每提示 16 个回答、temperature/top-p 1.0、固定 seed 1，并且除非另有说明，数学 eta 为 8、代码 eta 为 4。配置表写最大生成 27,648 token，而表 1 写 32K；没有不可变运行配置解决这一差异。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The evidence bundle verifies the official NeurIPS proceedings, arXiv record, AReaL project, maintained repository and Apache-2.0 license. They establish an asynchronous systems release and paper-level math/code recipe. The NeurIPS checklist says the paper releases no new assets; upstream data and models are open-source inputs. The current repository is a living framework and may link a broad Models & Data collection, but no specific artifact was verified as the immutable NeurIPS experiment's data, trajectory, reward, verifier or checkpoint release. The paper implementation reports Python/PyTorch, SGLang 0.4.6, Megatron-Core 0.11.0 and SLURM, but not a full container/image/cluster reproduction bundle.

证据账本已核验官方 NeurIPS proceedings、arXiv 条目、AReaL 项目页、维护中的仓库和 Apache-2.0 许可证。它们建立的是异步系统发布和论文层面的数学/代码配方。NeurIPS checklist 表示论文不发布新资产，上游数据和模型来自开源输入。当前仓库是持续演化的框架，可能链接宽泛的 Models & Data 集合，但没有具体工件被核验为 NeurIPS 实验不可变的数据、轨迹、奖励、验证器或检查点发布。论文实现报告 Python/PyTorch、SGLang 0.4.6、Megatron-Core 0.11.0 与 SLURM，但没有完整的容器/镜像/集群复现包。

title: Novelty
新意
html: For this atlas, AReaL's distinctive contribution is the explicit systems contract for stale and cross-version reasoning rollouts. It exposes an interruptible worker, controller-side freshness policy, replay-buffer handling, CPU reward service and a decoupled PPO objective that distinguishes behavior from proximal policy. That allows audit of operational feedback and policy-version boundaries that ordinary RLVR descriptions often omit. It remains a construction-recipe and verifier/reward disclosure: runnable high-throughput infrastructure, reported source names and hyperparameters are not equivalent to a released reasoning corpus or an auditable record-to-update ledger. Evidence-backed uses are RLVR and evaluation.

对本图谱而言，AReaL 的区别性贡献是明确披露了陈旧和跨版本推理 rollout 的系统契约。它公开了可中断 worker、控制器端新鲜度策略、replay buffer 处理、CPU 奖励服务以及区分行为策略与近端策略的解耦 PPO 目标。这使得审计操作反馈和策略版本边界成为可能，而这些常被普通 RLVR 描述省略。它仍是构建配方和验证器/奖励披露：可运行的高吞吐基础设施、报告的来源名称和超参数，不等于已发布推理语料或可审计的记录到更新账本。有证据支持的用途为 RLVR 和评估。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Excessive staleness lowers final performance in the paper; decoupled PPO is not staleness invariant. Cross-version interrupted trajectories require behavior/proximal-policy metadata and token-level evidence for off-policy auditing, but no run ledger is released. Exact string match and unit tests can be brittle or incomplete proxies for semantic reasoning, security, robustness and program validity. Source-row identifiers, source revisions, mixture rules, filtering, deduplication, split mapping, rights and contamination evidence for DeepScaleR and DeepCoder are unavailable. Math parsing, code extraction, test/sandbox versions, reward decisions and terminal records remain unresolved. The large-scale results are single trials with fixed seed one and no error bars, and the two generation-length statements conflict. Current framework code is not a version-pinned reproduction package for the paper run.

论文中，过度陈旧会降低最终性能；解耦 PPO 并不对陈旧度不变。跨版本、被中断的轨迹需要行为/近端策略元数据和 token 级证据才能进行 off-policy 审计，但没有发布运行账本。精确字符串匹配和单元测试可能是语义推理、代码安全、鲁棒性和程序有效性的脆弱或不完整代理。DeepScaleR 和 DeepCoder 的来源行标识、来源修订、混合规则、筛选、去重、切分映射、权利和污染证据均不可得。数学解析、代码抽取、测试/沙盒版本、奖励判定和终止记录仍未解决。大规模结果是固定 seed 一的单次试验且没有误差条，两个生成长度说法也存在冲突。当前框架代码不是固定版本的论文运行复现包。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Evidence-backed uses are RLVR and evaluation at the systems-recipe level. This Card supports comparison of stale-policy handling, cross-version rollout semantics, outcome-only programmatic feedback, replay-buffer rules and PPO configuration. It must not be used to assert access to the NeurIPS prompt mixture, generated reasoning traces, token logprobs, policy-version spans, reward events, unit-test bundle, data split or checkpoints. Reuse requires immutable source/prompt manifests, run logs and update lineage, exact verifier artifacts, a rights and contamination audit, pinned software/container/cluster settings, resolved configuration and multi-seed results.

有证据支持的用途是在系统配方层面进行 RLVR 和评估。本卡支持比较旧策略处理、跨版本 rollout 语义、仅结果的程序化反馈、replay buffer 规则和 PPO 配置。它不能被用于声称获得了 NeurIPS 提示混合、生成推理轨迹、token logprob、策略版本跨度、奖励事件、单元测试包、数据切分或检查点。复用前需要不可变来源/提示清单、运行日志和更新血缘、精确验证器工件、权利与污染审计、固定的软件/容器/集群设置、已解决的配置差异和多随机种子结果。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• System unit to inspect: interruptible rollout worker, controller staleness gate, replay buffer, CPU reward service and separate trainer cluster.
  • Reward/verifier contract to verify: plus five/minus five only at the final action; math string match and code extraction plus unit tests.
  • Configuration issue to retain: 512 prompts, 16 answers, temperature/top-p 1.0 and seed 1; 27,648-token table versus 32K Table 1 remains unreconciled.
  • Reuse gate before relying on results: paper-run source/prompt/split manifests, cross-version trajectory and reward logs, verifier bundle, rights/contamination audit and pinned reproducibility package.

• 应核查的系统单元：可中断 rollout worker、控制器陈旧度门、replay buffer、CPU 奖励服务和独立 trainer 集群。
  • 应核查的奖励/验证器契约：仅最终动作正五/负五；数学字符串匹配，代码抽取加单元测试。
  • 应保留的配置问题：512 个提示、16 个回答、temperature/top-p 1.0 和 seed 1；27,648 token 配置表与表 1 的 32K 尚未解决。
  • 依赖结果前的复用门槛：论文运行来源/提示/切分清单、跨版本轨迹与奖励日志、验证器包、权利/污染审计和固定的复现包。
